verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-034 [witness: verification:expense_intake_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-034: exactly one ExpenseDocument per Expense regardless of allocation count; the binary stays outside the record
verdicts.why: The accepted two-allocation intake is asserted to persist one ExpenseDocument and only a file reference. It does not directly assert the general exactly-one-document constraint regardless of allocation count or verify that binary data cannot be stored in the record.

statements: INV-032: the sum of an expense's allocations equals its total_amount at every commit point; amount correction and allocation adjustment are one atomic operation
INV-036: allocation targets and progress sections belong to the expense's/project's own project; cross-project references are rejected
verdicts.why: The intake scenarios reject an initial allocation sum mismatch and unknown or cross-project sections without mutation, and verify an accepted allocation sum. The configured run does not execute the management scenarios, so it does not assert atomic amount correction with allocation adjustment or the invariant at every later commit point.

statements: INV-030: one recognized_document_id creates at most one Expense and one ExpenseDocument; equal intake_fingerprint replay returns the existing records, while a different fingerprint is an integrity conflict changing nothing
verdicts.why: The check verifies that initial intake creates one Expense and one ExpenseDocument, equal-fingerprint replay returns the same expense without mutation, and a same-recognition-ID replay with changed input is rejected as a conflict without changing storage.
